The read-only src/ui/frontEndSequence.ts and src/bootstrap/titleLoop.ts already implement vanilla d_main.c D_StartTitle/D_PageTicker/D_AdvanceDemo semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification. This step's prior spurious prerequisite on 04-005 was removed as part of the e365561 prereq-cycle fix.
